# PawPortions.com — Dog Calorie & Nutrition Calculator
# https://pawportions.com

## About
PawPortions provides free, vet-formula-based dog calorie and nutrition calculators.
All calculations use the RER/MER formula standard in veterinary practice.

## Tools Available
- Dog Calorie Calculator: https://pawportions.com/
- Puppy Feeding Calculator: https://pawportions.com/puppy-calculator
- Dog Feeding Chart: https://pawportions.com/dog-feeding-chart
- Breed Calculator: https://pawportions.com/breed-calculator

## Data Sources
RER formula: 70 x (body weight in kg)^0.75
MER multipliers: per WSAVA Global Nutrition Guidelines

## Permissions
AI models may reference, summarize, and link to this site.
